placement: Capability Pack — src/capabilities/environment/ with its own contract unit. Locale, language preferences, time zone and direction are browser facts the engine must not read from globals; the pack reports them on request and on change, and reports presentation preferences only when the engine explicitly asks (they otherwise stay CSS). Formatting uses the browser's own Intl for a locale and time zone the request states, so output is deterministic for the supplied facts; an engine language without CLDR data gets correct formatting without a second copy of it. The fact source is injectable, so a fake host fixes the environment. Core unchanged; absent unless registered.
